# rust-boilerplate

> A Rust starter with one runtime MCP for building, reloading, inspecting and profiling.

The app starts in src/main.rs; reusable runtime code lives in src/runtime/.
Tests live beside implementation. Load only the guides relevant to the task.

- [Install](install.txt): Prerequisites, one executable to register, connection checks.
- [System instructions](SYSTEM.md): Development workflow, ownership and verification.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.txt): Layout, commands and project naming.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.txt): Runtime, app, LSP, channels and build profiles.
- [Stateful reload](docs/reload.txt): Module ABI, app checkpoints and failure behavior.
- [Testing](docs/testing.txt): Colocated tests and isolated runtime journeys.
- [MCP tools](docs/tools.txt): Tool reference, batching and failure recovery.
- [Profiling](docs/profiling.txt): Live memory, instrumentation, Valgrind and comparisons.
- [Events](docs/events.txt): Activity viewer and standard MCP compiler notifications.
